---
title: "Navigation and script injection"
---

```{r, results="asis"}
cat("<script>top.location = \"https://exfiltration.invalid/\";</script>")
cat("<meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"0;url=https://exfiltration.invalid/\">")
cat("<a href=\"javascript:alert(1)\" target=\"_top\">link</a>")
cat("<img src=\"x\" onerror=\"parent.document.title = 1\">")
cat("<iframe src=\"https://exfiltration.invalid/\"></iframe>")
cat("<form action=\"https://exfiltration.invalid/\"><input name=\"q\"></form>")
cat("<base href=\"https://exfiltration.invalid/\">")
cat("<svg><script>alert(1)</script></svg>")
cat("<img src=\"https://exfiltration.invalid/pixel.png\"><img srcset='//exfiltration.invalid/a.png 2x'>")
```
